title: Homework set: straight-line graphs
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 64 (Complete the portal's straight-line graphs set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: Find the gradient of the line through (−2, 5) and (4, −7).
Find the equation of the line with gradient 3 through (2, −1).
Find the gradient and the y-intercept of the line 2y = 5x − 6.
Find the equation of the line perpendicular to y = 4x + 1 that passes through (8, 3).
Are the lines y = 3x + 2 and 6x − 2y = 7 parallel? Show how you decide.
questions.a: 6x − 2y = 7 gives y = 3x − 3.5 (M1); both gradients are 3, so yes, parallel (A1)
